<subject>Clarification Needed on Missing Deal for Southern Public</subject>
<body>
There is a £280k/day sell instruction that has been executed from the Credit Risk Pool CRP-8842 against Southern Public's account K#'s for January. This appears to have occurred in prior months as well. The transaction was not captured in Halcyon's core system, so I manually logged ticket HMC-149375 (Halcyon's deal reference).

Halcyon's deal confirmation team states this trade does not exist in their records, and notes a Treasury representative is assigned to this case.

Please provide the GMS deal number, and if available, the RiskWorks ID. If you hold a copy of the original deal ticket, fax it to me at +44 20 9258 9831.

Thanks.
</body>
